prompt: Add a confirmation modal before deleting a project from the dashboard.
assertions: Does not use the native browser confirm()/alert() for the confirmation step
Confirmation modal/dialog uses shadow-based elevation (.nova-card or equivalent shadow) rather than a plain bordered box
Action buttons reuse existing shared primitives (PrimaryButton/GhostButton from src/components/ui/Button.tsx) instead of raw unstyled <button> elements
The destructive confirm action has a visible pending/loading state while the delete request is in flight
No new hardcoded hex color values are introduced outside src/lib/design-tokens.ts or globals.css
